words.intro: His memories are hiding in the letters.
words.foundText: You found the words he couldn’t hold on to.

memories.reveal: her warm hand tucked inside his
memories.line: Home wasn’t a place… It was wherever she held my hand.

memories.reveal: empty swings moving in perfectly still air
memories.line: he voices weren’t coming from the playground

memories.reveal: her hands covering his eyes while someone counted
memories.line: My mother was hiding something from me.” Or… hiding me from them.
